_note: Region data for the Q1-type area items of 25S-C. RAW_SCHEMA has no `region` field, so it lives here. Ids are built question ids. Q1c, Q1d are moments (no region).

25S-C-Q1a.distribution: uniform on the sample space (b~U(0,1), L~U(1,2) independent); a = (L-b)/2
25S-C-Q1a.eventBoundary: line L = b + 1/2, entering the rectangle at (1/2, 1) and leaving at (1, 3/2)

25S-C-Q1b.eventBoundary: line L = b + 4/3, meeting the top edge L=2 at b=2/3
